Metadata.title: CamiloShop — Tech, beauty and urban fashion
Metadata.description: Online store for tech, cosmetics and clothing with an urban style. Portfolio project with sandbox payments.

Common.portfolioNotice: Portfolio project: payments run in sandbox mode and no real money is charged.

Preferences.currencyNote: USD prices are approximate. You are always charged in COP.

Home.heroText: Tech, beauty and fashion curated with style. Free shipping on orders from COP 200,000.
Home.benefitShippingText: On orders from COP 200,000 anywhere in Colombia.
Home.benefitPaymentText: Card, PSE or cash on delivery.

Product.usdNote: Approximate USD price; you are charged in COP.

Footer.tagline: Tech, beauty and fashion with an urban style.
